sentences.text:
Heard learned
counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Balumath P.S. Case No. 23 of 2020,
registered under sections 379/406/420/467/471/120B/468 of the I.P.C. pending in the Court of
learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar.

entities.text:
Court of
learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case and the co-accused persons have been granted anticipatory bail contained in annexure-2.
He submits that the petitioner has alrredy received notice under section 41-A of the Cr.P.C.
On these grounds, he submits that the petitioner may kindly be provided privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State submits that petitioner is not co-operating in the investigation.

5. In view of above facts, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned court within two weeks from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order and the learned court will release the petitioner on proper sureties as learned court deems fit and proper.
6. This anticipatory bail application is disposed of.
